events.title: Latin-X-Tech
events.description: In celebration of Hispanic Heritage Month, TechTown Detroit presents Latin-X-Tech! A free, community-centered event highlighting the stories, talents, and impact of Latinx and Hispanic entrepreneurs in tech and entrepreneurship. Latin-X-Tech: Powering the Next Generation is a free, community-centered event highlighting the stories, talents, and impact of Latinx and Hispanic entrepreneurs, professionals, students, creatives, and innovators in technology and entrepreneurship. Join us October 14 from 5:00–9:00 PM at TechTown Detroit for an evening of conversation, connection, resources, food, and community. The main event is a three-speaker panel exploring one simple idea: There isn’t one way to build a career in technology. Our panel will bring together a founder, software engineer, and academia to discuss the different paths into technology and how we can make sure Latinx students and professionals can see themselves in all of them. Technology isn’t just about building the next app. It’s about identifying problems, understanding people, building solutions, and creating opportunities. We can build the technology, research the problem, start the company, work inside the company, support the people building it, shape the community around it, invest in it, or lead it. There is more than one way to be part of the technology ecosystem. Beyond the panel, attendees can connect with our local Entrepreneurship Support Organizations (ESOs) from across the community and discover resources for entrepreneurs and small businesses. We’ll also have HR specialists providing career-readiness support and resume reviews for college students and professionals, so bring a current copy of your resume if you’d like feedback. And of course, there will be free food and plenty of opportunities to connect. Explore our Mercadito Alleyway, featuring small community pop-ups where you can discover and support local creators and businesses offering everything from books to art, trinkets, and other unique finds. Whether you’re a student exploring your future, a professional looking to break into tech, an entrepreneur, engineer, researcher, creative, small business owner, or simply curious about what’s possible, Latin-X-Tech is a place to connect, learn, and discover your path in technology. Make sure to save your spot here !

events.title: AI & Automation: Build Night 101
events.description: Join us for our AI Build Night 101! These are beginner-friendly, hands-on experience designed for exploring new tools, professionals looking to streamline their work, or simply someone curious about what AI can actually do beyond the hype. This session is built for those who have heard the buzz, maybe experimented with a few tools, but still feel unsure about how to apply AI and Automation in a meaningful, practical way. Instead of overwhelming you with technical jargon or abstract concepts, we focus on breaking everything down into clear, simple ideas you can immediately understand and use. Throughout the session, we take a practical, step-by-step approach to demystifying AI and Automation. You’ll learn what these tools actually are (and aren’t), how they fit into real workflows, and where they can create the most impact in your day-to-day work. We’ll explore accessible, no-code and low-code tools that allow you to build without needing a technical background, and we’ll show you how small automations can lead to significant time savings and increased productivity. Participants won’t just sit and listen because you’ll be actively building. Through guided exercises and real-world examples, you’ll start creating simple automations, experimenting with AI-powered tools, and thinking through how these solutions can apply to your own goals. Whether it’s automating repetitive administrative tasks, organizing and analyzing information more efficiently, improving customer interactions, or quickly prototyping a new idea, you’ll walk away having already taken action. Beyond the tools themselves, this Build Night 101 is a beginner course built to build confidence and shift your mindset. AI and Automation can feel intimidating at first, but once you understand the fundamentals, they become powerful, approachable resources that anyone can use. By the end of the session, you’ll not only have a stronger understanding of what’s possible, but also a clearer sense of how to continue exploring and building on your own. Come ready to learn by doing, ask questions, experiment freely, and connect with others who are on a similar journey. You’ll leave with practical knowledge, tangible progress, and a solid foundation to start integrating AI and Automation into your work, your projects, and your everyday life. Join us every month for our AI Build Night 101 and become part of our ecosystem. Reserve your spot today !

In this 90-minute hybrid workshop, Laura Wood-Romito of the MSU Product Center, in partnership with TechTown Detroit, walks food entrepreneurs through the essentials of creating professional, compliant product labels. Whether you’re launching a new product or refreshing an existing one, you’ll leave ready to stand out on the shelf while meeting regulatory standards. What You’ll Gain A clear understanding of the key labeling requirements for food products The ability to spot and avoid common compliance pitfalls before they cost you Strategies for balancing legal requirements with strong branding and attractive packaging Guidance on what health claims you can and can’t make Practical packaging considerations for getting your product market-ready Cost-effective approaches to producing labels that work for both regulators and consumers

events.title: AI & Automation: Build Night 101
events.description: Join us for our AI Build Night 101! These are beginner-friendly, hands-on experience designed for exploring new tools, professionals looking to streamline their work, or simply someone curious about what AI can actually do beyond the hype. This session is built for those who have heard the buzz, maybe experimented with a few tools, but still feel unsure about how to apply AI and Automation in a meaningful, practical way. Instead of overwhelming you with technical jargon or abstract concepts, we focus on breaking everything down into clear, simple ideas you can immediately understand and use. Throughout the session, we take a practical, step-by-step approach to demystifying AI and Automation. You’ll learn what these tools actually are (and aren’t), how they fit into real workflows, and where they can create the most impact in your day-to-day work. We’ll explore accessible, no-code and low-code tools that allow you to build without needing a technical background, and we’ll show you how small automations can lead to significant time savings and increased productivity. Participants won’t just sit and listen because you’ll be actively building. Through guided exercises and real-world examples, you’ll start creating simple automations, experimenting with AI-powered tools, and thinking through how these solutions can apply to your own goals. Whether it’s automating repetitive administrative tasks, organizing and analyzing information more efficiently, improving customer interactions, or quickly prototyping a new idea, you’ll walk away having already taken action. Beyond the tools themselves, this Build Night 101 is a beginner course built to build confidence and shift your mindset. AI and Automation can feel intimidating at first, but once you understand the fundamentals, they become powerful, approachable resources that anyone can use. By the end of the session, you’ll not only have a stronger understanding of what’s possible, but also a clearer sense of how to continue exploring and building on your own. Come ready to learn by doing, ask questions, experiment freely, and connect with others who are on a similar journey. You’ll leave with practical knowledge, tangible progress, and a solid foundation to start integrating AI and Automation into your work, your projects, and your everyday life. Join us every month for our AI Build Night 101 and become part of our ecosystem. Reserve your spot today !

events.description: @ Be among the first to explore the findings of the Detroit Regional Chamber’s 13th annual State of the Region report. Released on March 24, 2027, the report will deliver a comprehensive snapshot of the Detroit Region’s economic health, highlighting the trends shaping its future. At the event, Chamber President and Chief Executive Officer Sandy K. Baruah will present the report’s key findings, and a panel of business and economic leaders will discuss the implications of the data and what it signals for the Region’s future prosperity and competitiveness.
